query_top3.text:
a) Prerequisite course: If Course A is a prerequisite for Course B, learners must successfully
complete Course A before enrolling in Course B.

b) Pre -study course: If Course A is a pre -study course for Course B, learners must have
registered for and completed Course A (not necessarily passed) before enrolling in Course B.

c) Concurrent course: If Course A is a concurrent course with Course B, learners must take
Course A either before or at the same time as Course B.
